from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PAGE = ROOT / 'frontend/src/pages/Finanzas.js'
UI = ROOT / 'frontend/src/components/finanzas/FinanzasDecisionPago.jsx'
ROUTER = ROOT / 'backend/modules/finanzas/cuentas_por_pagar.py'


def read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')


def test_decision_pago_does_not_load_full_cxp_bundle():
    page = read(PAGE)

    assert "activeTab === 'cxp' ||\n      activeTab === 'decision-pago'" not in page
    assert "(activeTab === 'cxp' || activeTab === 'decision-pago')" not in page

    start = page.index('const renderDecisionPago')
    end = page.index('const renderComprobaciones', start)
    block = page[start:end]

    assert 'cxpData={cxpData}' not in block
    assert 'onActualizar={loadCuentasPorPagar}' not in block
    assert 'loading={loading}' not in block


def test_decision_dashboard_is_authoritative_for_main_kpis_and_refresh():
    ui = read(UI)

    assert 'cxpData,' not in ui
    assert 'const facturas = useMemo' not in ui
    assert 'metrics.saldo' not in ui
    assert 'metrics.seleccionado' not in ui
    assert 'metrics.autorizado' not in ui

    assert 'decisionResumen.saldo_cxp' in ui
    assert 'decisionResumen.comprometido' in ui
    assert 'decisionResumen.autorizado' in ui
    assert 'decisionResumen.limite_pago' in ui
    assert 'decisionResumen.disponible' in ui
    assert 'decisionResumen.porcentaje_utilizado' in ui

    assert 'decisionRefreshKey' in ui
    assert 'setDecisionRefreshKey' in ui
    assert 'onActualizar' not in ui
    assert "if (value == null) return 'No disponible';" in ui
    assert 'decisionResumen.saldo_cxp != null' in ui


def test_cxp_full_list_propagates_current_user_to_factura_dict():
    router = read(ROUTER)

    assert 'unidades_permitidas=None, current_user=None):' in router
    assert '_cxp_factura_dict(r, current_user)' in router

    start = router.index('async def listar_facturas_pendientes')
    end = router.index('@router.get("/resumen")', start)
    block = router[start:end]

    assert 'current_user,' in block
    assert '_cxp_listar_canonico(' in block


def test_decision_dashboard_preserves_canonical_sources():
    router = read(ROUTER)

    assert 'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_Sync' in router
    assert 'dbo.Compras_Recepciones' in router
    assert 'MongoClient' not in router
    assert 'pymongo' not in router
